title: Give principles a check you can run, a not-when line, and fix the broken sibling name
action: Adopt the L7 principle-craft practices into the twelve listed skills only (per D2 and D4); new principles are Slice 3 and not part of this cell. Edit SKILL.md bodies only — never the principle index rows (their grammar is parsed and pinned by principle_index_parity.rs) and never the expertise guides (other cells own them). Keep each skill short, with its named example and its Depth line. Do NOT run bee dev regen (wave-barrier). (1) Add one `**Check:**` line, a yes or no question the agent can answer in the moment, before `**Why:**` in: single-source-of-truth ('change the value once; if you must edit a second file, elect the owner'), one-fact-one-home, smallest-honest-shape, split-never-shrink, record-at-the-moment-of-settlement, chestertons-fence. (2) Add one `**Not when:**` line to the broad ones: red-before-green (the failure cannot be automated; then the reproduce-first repro is the red) and verify-before-reporting. (3) red-before-green gains a delegation line: a worker's done-report is a prediction too; read its diff and proof line before you repeat green. (4) test-behavior-not-structure gains a vacuity check: the test must fail if the subject returns nothing, with three named shapes (no real assertion, a constant pin, a self-referential expected value). (5) crash-site-versus-fault-site: once the origin is found, search for the same shape elsewhere and fix every instance in the same cell. (6) the-deletion-test gains a second question: can a new reader answer where X comes from and what can change X? (7) reproduce-first: its 'Not the same as' line names `principle-red-before-green` without the load-bearing prefix; change it to `bee-principle-red-before-green`. Add a 'Not the same as' line between single-source-of-truth and one-fact-one-home (a code fact against a knowledge entry) and between verify-before-reporting and red-before-green.
